subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in a sentence.

Andrew was a very gentle and __courteous__ man with huge respect for everyone he worked with.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Impolite**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'antonym' means a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Now, let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "courteous" means polite and pleasant, showing respect for other people.** (शिष्‍ट, भद्र, विनम्र और प्रीतिकर)
 
 
• Example: Hina's reply was courteous but firm.
 
 
 
• **'Impolite' fits as the antonym because it means lacking in manners or showing disrespect.(**असभ्य)
 
 
• Example: Her way of responding was very impolite.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "impolite" is the antonym of the word "courteous."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Humble (means modest or unassuming, not the opposite of gentle) (विनम्र)
 
• Courageous (means brave or daring, not the opposite of gentle) (साहसिक)
 
• Refined (means elegant or cultured, not the opposite of gentle) (परिशोधित)
